segments.name: Rare disease therapies
segments.description: Develops rare disease therapies, advancing product candidates through clinical development toward partnering or commercialization.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating segment focused on the business of developing rare disease therapies.

revenueModel.text: Partners pay the Company upfront license fees, milestone payments, and royalties on net sales under licensing and collaboration agreements for its product candidates.
revenueModel.evidence: Under both licensing and collaboration agreements, rights to product candidates are provided to a partner typically in exchange for consideration in the form of upfront payments and/or development, regulatory, commercial or other similar milestones, and royalties on commercial sales, should regulatory approval be obtained for the product candidates.
